generation_history.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE transparent 4-column by 3-row sprite atlas containing EXACTLY 12 equal square cells, read left to right then top to bottom. Input 1 is the character identity reference: preserve their distinct face, eye shape, hair, default costume and weapon. Input 2 is the approved Nia ultimate sprite-atlas STYLE reference ONLY; never give this person Nia's face. Match thick cute chibi pixel art: large head, short limbs, crisp square pixel clusters, dark contour, restrained cel shading, readable eyes and small mouth. A real 12-frame motion animation, 8fps/1.5 seconds. Full body each cell, same body scale, pivot and foot baseline; generous transparent margin; all effects stay strictly inside their own cell. Frame 1 resting pose, frame 12 return to same resting pose. Actual different limb, torso, weapon poses throughout, never a frozen body with only effects swapped. 3/4 front facing right, character occupies middle 55% of cell, no camera movement, no text, no numbers, no grid, no scenery, no background or extra generic enemies. Keep face unobscured. Darko, gray teal spiky hair, round glasses, black gray clothes and bat from identity. Official R grabs, drags and slams the captured target into the ground. Without drawing an opponent, animate open grabbing hand reaching right, fist clenching around an abstract tiny violet VF knot, low dragging run with torso forward and bat swept behind, hauling arm upward, violent overhead downward throw, kneeling slam with gold-gray ground impact ring, recoil, stand and reset. Not a bat swing alone: emphasize grabbing and dragging then downward slam. Eyes behind glasses remain readable. Frame actions 1-12: 준비; 손 뻗기; 붙잡기; 끌고 가기; 이동 가속; 팔 들어올리기; 내리꽂기 준비; 지면에 내리꽂기; 충격; 반동; 일어서기; 준비 복귀.

Identity errata for this fresh generation: the first prompt mistakenly says glasses. Darko has NO glasses at any time; do not copy the accidental round glasses in the tiny identity sprite. Keep his asymmetrical spiky gray-teal hair, narrow reddish visible eye and sly small smile. His original outfit is a dark gray-teal patterned long coat with broad tan-gray geometric trims, navy open shirt, gold chains/coins and gray sneakers. His consistent weapon is a dark shaft with a flat oval silver metal striking head, not a plain wooden bat. Use teal and gold accents for the grab-drag-slam effects. Keep every other original prompt style, layout and motion instruction above unchanged. Match the original approved Nia pixel-art reference for the drawing language; do not redesign the scene or use newer animation sheets.
